leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a multi-step form component with separate sections for each step
Implement state management to track the current step and form data
Configure navigation controls to move between form steps
Bind form inputs to component properties using Angular's two-way data binding
Apply validation logic to control step progression
Render dynamic step indicators that update based on current progress
Integrate form submission logic that processes all collected data
